audit.why: The level chart (Jayce / Skill / Skill / Jayce / Ambessa / Ambessa / Skill) already matches the mirror audit at audits/top/ambessa__jayce.json, which set exactly this chart, and it matches every why on this page. Reused rather than re-derived.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes reads 'Ambessa: Repeating Dashes online, level 6, first item' — the first item is a non-existent ability, and the level-6 entry gives no reason. The Itemization line also prescribes early anti-heal 'because his healing fights your pattern'.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130s at rank 1 with 1250 range — that is the level-6 spike and the number that tells you how long you have after she misses it. The anti-heal instruction is unfounded: no ability in Riot's text for Ambessa heals, and the gold is better spent on armour.
audit.corrected: Spike line now names Lacerate; Itemization drops the anti-heal buy and explains why; cooldowns carry the real R figures.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability. It appears 25 times across the full layer — in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, three phase reasons, seven breakdown fields, the dos/donts and six report entries — as the single ability the player is told to track.
audit.why: Her abilities are Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E) and Public Execution (R). The mechanic the fabricated name was reaching for is real but split across two of them: Drakehound's Step is a passive that grants a free dash after every ability cast, and Lacerate (E, 13/12/11/10/9s) is the repeat-dash engage that actually carries a cooldown. focus.letters already pointed at E.
audit.corrected: Every occurrence replaced with Lacerate (E). breakdown.cooldowns and the Key Ability Interactions entry now state the split explicitly: the passive is why counting her dashes fails, and Lacerate's 13s is the timer to poke on.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole content entry — early, mid, late and all seven whys — is written in the first person ('The opening is mine', 'she only needs to land one Public Execution to delete me'). Every other Jayce matchup uses second person. The full layer also calls Ambessa 'he' in breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.trading and report[12].
audit.why: A page that switches to first person reads as a different author and breaks the coaching voice; the wrong pronoun reads as unmaintained data.
audit.corrected: All ten content fields converted to second person and the four pronoun errors fixed, within the length band.

edits.before: The opening is mine — Shock Blast fired through my Acceleration Gate out-ranges everything she has, and at level 1 she only has Cunning Sweep, so she has to dash into my face to touch me. Gate-Q her last-hits and let the post-swap Armor/MR shred chunk her every time she steps up to farm. Use my Hextech Capacitor move-speed on every swap to fire and reposition — I poke and slide back, I don't stand in her Q-dash range and brawl. If she dashes in with Cunning Sweep to all-in early, swap to Hammer and Thundering Blow her straight back out before her Lacerate recast lands.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay mine: her Cunning Sweep and Lacerate dash cooldowns are at their longest and she has no items yet to survive my burst, so I keep the poke war tilting my way — Shock Blast on every step-up, then a Cannon-Q into swap-shred into Hammer Q-E if she over-commits her dashes. At 6 it flips hard: Public Execution locks on, dashes her to me, goes untargetable through my Thundering Blow knockback, and snaps me back into her Lacerate combo before I can kite. So spend the health lead NOW. Once she hits 6, respect that her R-engage ignores my knockback peel entirely.

notes: Two things I did NOT change and want flagged. (1) The page asserts in spikes[1], mid, whys[4] and wants.foe[1] that Public Execution makes Ambessa UNTARGETABLE through Thundering Blow. Riot's text says she blinks to the target and suppresses them — it says nothing about untargetability, and the kit's needsResearch is empty, which means unknown, not false. I left every one of those sentences alone rather than assert or deny it; it needs confirming before it ships, because the advice 'your knockback peel does not work' is load-bearing. (2) _missing-interactions.json flags 'Ambessa sustains through chip damage (Public Execution (R)) — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades', and the kit carries a heal flag on R. Riot's own R description contains no healing, so per the tooltip-parsing caveat I trusted the description, did not write anti-heal advice, and removed the existing anti-heal instruction from Itemization. The mirror audit at audits/top/ambessa__jayce.json independently reached the same conclusion about Ambessa's phantom healing. Also carried over from that mirror: its open question about whether Jayce's two stances run independent cooldown timers, which affects every 'Shock Blast is back in X seconds' line I wrote.
